# Canada

Region: North America. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Payments Canada

**Role:** National payment-system and standards authority

**Reporting coverage:** Public draft corporate CAMT052/053/054 usage guidelines

**Messages / versions:** camt.052.001.06; camt.053.001.06; camt.054.001.06; pain; pacs

- [CAMT052 DraftUG2017](https://www.payments.ca/sites/default/files/2022-08/bank_to_corporate_messages_portfolio-_draft-_jan_banktocustomeraccountreportv06_20170130_1957_0.pdf) — specification; public-file

Corporate reporting usage guidelines on this page are explicitly DRAFT and for information only; the page says they must not be relied on for system development. V06 namespaces were verified inside PDFs. Separate AFT inter-FI messages are offered for use; Lynx and RTR specifications are separate.
